svg.title: T1 noise before the eruption
svg.text: T1: GRACE-FO laser-ranging residuals before the eruption

Residual range acceleration on 13–14 January 2022 (blind), against the instrument noise and the Lamb-wave signal it must reveal. GNV1B orbits: 4.8e-9 m/s² rms in band; fitted orbits: 3.4e-9 m/s² rms in band
